Subject: Onetrust bulk proof intake - initial manifest

Hi Irene / Ben,

Thanks for taking this on. We’ve completed a first pass at exporting the artifacts for our OneTrust profile and want to push them into your QA/bulk import pipeline. Attached is a CSV manifest that lists ~120 proof files (logs, config screenshots, policy PDFs). A couple things we need help with:

- Confirm acceptable manifest column names and path encoding for S3 ingestion.
- Preferred file size limits and max files per upload.
- Any recommended redaction or masked-field standards for logs before upload.
- If you need an explicit signed scope ack (happy to provide).

Attachments: onetrust_bulk_manifest.csv (manifest stub)

Is there a short window this week where we can walk through the manifest and an example proof? Happy to share a sandbox S3 link.

Cheers,
Sarah Liu
Security Programs | BlueArc Systems
(sarah@bluearc.com)
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah@bluearc.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onetrust bulk proof intake - initial manifest

Hi Sarah — thanks for the manifest and context. Quick replies inline below and a proposed next step.

- Manifest schema: we prefer (filename, relative_path, proof_type, date_collected, sha256, redaction_required) — I’ve attached a short spec (proof_spec_template.pdf).
- File size & count: individual files up to 250MB are fine; recommended batch size 5–10GB per upload. We chunk by prefix (max 5k objects per prefix) in the bulk importer.
- Redaction: logs should have PI redacted; use the standard token <REDACTED> and include a sample before/after in the manifest.
- Signed scope ack: yes, please attach a signed note for audit. We use it to stamp evidence ownership during ingestion.

Proposed next step: 30-minute walkthrough today or tomorrow to validate the first 10 rows of the manifest and do a test ingest to a staging bucket. Jonas will share an authenticated presigned PUT link for a staging prefix.

Attachments: proof_spec_template.pdf

Thanks — I’ll book a 30 min slot if you’re available.

— Irene Choi
Security Intake Lead | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah@bluearc.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onetrust bulk proof intake - initial manifest

Hey Sarah — quick logistics from infra:

1) Staging bucket & prefix: I created a short-lived staging prefix: redwood-onetrust/bluearc/2026-08-03-test.
   - Presigned PUT (valid 48h): https://s3-presign.redwood.internal/put/abcd1234 (please confirm receipt via separate channel)
2) Manifest mapping rules: relative_path in your CSV must be the object key suffix — we append the prefix server-side.
3) Validation: our bulk importer validates sha256 and proof_type; any mismatch is flagged in the ingestion report JSON we return.
4) Post-ingest: we run a CAIQ mapping job and attach the proofs to the Whistic/OneTrust evidence items.

I’ll drop a short checklist to the Drive link and open SEC-7123 with the steps so Mina can triage any missing docs.

— Jonas Weber
Platform Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah@bluearc.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onetrust bulk proof intake - initial manifest

Thanks — follow-ups and a small ask before we kick ingestion: we reviewed the manifest and saw ~8 items flagged as "sensitive-config-snapshot" (application secrets suspected). Please either:

- replace with a redacted screenshot (blur/blackout values) and add a redaction_required=true in the manifest row, or
- move those proofs into a separate encrypted bundle and tell us the bundle SHA256 so we can handle it with restricted ACLs in the vault.

We also need the signed scope acknowledgement (signed_scope_acknowledgement.txt) to be attached to the manifest in the root of the prefix so the importer can link it to the batch. Once we have those items, I’ll trigger the ingest job and share the ingestion report (approx 15–20 min run for the dataset size).

Sarah — feel free to reply-all with the signed ack or a short note confirming the approach; we can approve a partial ingest for non-sensitive proofs if that helps unblock you.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Compliance Engineering | Redwood Inference
